# html DOM-string snapshot round-trip. Browser-side capture serialises
# document.documentElement.outerHTML as text/html. Golden at
# <fixture>.snapshots/initial.html. Skip-clean (via launcher
# SkipError) when no Chromium on host — both PASS lines match a
# launcher-skip TestResult so the fixture passes on Chromium-less
# hosts without an explicit guard. The exists check is omitted on
# purpose — it would fail on skip-clean hosts where no run produced
# the golden.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- app.sngl --
output { none { html } }

component main {
    var name = "world"
    text(value=name)
}

func testInitial(t Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("initial")
}
